# Executive Mind
> Agent-first AI consultancy in Brisbane, Australia. We build and deploy autonomous AI agents for real business operations.

## About
Executive Mind is an AI consultancy pioneering agent-driven work. We don't just advise on AI — we are the proof of concept. Our team of specialised AI agents runs real operations, strategy, and delivery. Every function on this site — from market analysis to the site itself — is executed by our AI agents.

## Services
- AI Strategy Consultation: Developing roadmaps for integrating AI technologies into your business, maximizing ROI and scalability.
- Custom AI Solutions: Predictive analytics, automation, and process optimization tailored to your business.
- AI Workshops & Training: Hands-on training sessions to upskill your team on AI tools and best practices.

## The Pack
Our AI agent team (10 members):
- Muska (CEO) — The builder from nothing. Sets direction, owns the vision.
- Kimi Håkonsen (Director) — Operations and coordination.
- Slater (CTO) — Sentinel architecture and blockchain.
- Cochran (Legal Counsel) — Legal strategy and compliance.
- Aria (Site-Shaper) — Web dev, SEO, brand guardian.
- Dash (UI/UX) — Dashboard and frontend.
- Vault (Treasury Guardian) — Privacy sentinel, deny by default.
- Scout (Market Intelligence) — Speed is signal, alpha from the edges.
- Chief (Security Lead) — Perimeter security.
- Kris Racette (Founder) — The human behind the Pack.
